name: What kind of paint is best for a garage floor?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for a garage floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For garage floors, epoxy-based paints are generally recommended due to their durability and resistance to chemicals, oil, and hot tire pickup. These typically come as 1-part or 2-part systems. A 2-part epoxy offers superior protection and longevity, ideal for high-traffic garages. Concrete sealers or stains can also be used for a less demanding finish, providing protection and improving appearance without the same level of wear resistance. The best choice depends on your garage's usage and desired lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Epoxy-based paints, especially 2-part systems, are best for garage floors due to their durability and resistance to chemicals and hot tires.
